parts.text:
For Paimon, the tea party is a great way to catch up with friends over tea and snacks. However, this seems to be an experience that is utterly foreign to the Tsaritsa...

#### Go to the Zapolyarny Palace

**Anastasya:** Hello again, Traveler and Paimon.

- **Traveler:** What do you need from us this time, Your Majesty?

**Anastasya:** Have you ever heard of something called a tea party? Often held between ladies?

**Paimon:** Of course! It's when friends get together to eat sweets, drink tea, and have fun conversations!

**Anastasya:** Hm, so it's a common social gathering among the people then. I have never attended one myself.

**Paimon:** Do you want to?

**Anastasya:** The thought has indeed crossed my mind... To me, social events have always felt like an excuse to conduct official business in a different setting. Many of the banquets I attend are like that.

**Anastasya:** But, considering your description just now, a tea party seems quite different.

**Paimon:** For sure! Tea parties aren't for discussing official business at all.

- **Traveler:** We could help you arrange one.

**Anastasya:** I suppose I should experience it at least once, if only to understand the social proclivities of my people. But who would I invite?

**Paimon:** Anyone you consider a close friend, really...

**Anastasya:** I...

- **Traveler:** I have an idea, Your Majesty. What if I extend an invitation to some of my friends? Then, you could attend as a friend of mine as well.

**Anastasya:** A friend of yours... Very well, make the arrangements.

**Chayka:** Have you decided who to invite?

**Paimon:** Since it's a ladies' get-together the Tsaritsa wants... Guess we should start gathering the ladies. Oh, and we should probably limit it to people in Snezhnaya for convenience.

- **Traveler:** I know who to invite.

**Chayka:** Alright, just provide me with a list, and I'll send out the invitations for you.

#### Wait until two days later

#### Say hi to your friends who are here

**Paimon:** Hi, Odette. Hi, Vodyanitsa.

**Vodyanitsa:** Hm, I'm not sure if I should stay...

**Paimon:** What's wrong? Don't you like tea parties, Vodyanitsa?

**Vodyanitsa:** Of course I do! Any opportunity to chat with other people, I'm all for it! It's just, what if our identity is exposed? We're part of the Rokot, y'know.

**Vodyanitsa:** The commander of the Druzhna is sharp. We can't afford to be careless.

**Paimon:** Hm. Good point...

**Odette:** Maybe it'd be better if you didn't talk this time.

**Vodyanitsa:** What? I'd be so bored! You know I can't hold back when I've got something to say!

**Odette:** So, you want to just... disappear instead?

**Vodyanitsa:** You're right, that would be even more suspicious... Okay, deep breaths. Whew... I meet with fans all the time. I can handle a crowd.

**Paimon:** You sure it's gonna be fine?

**Odette:** Just leave her to me.

**Paimon:** Columbina!? You're here!?

**The Damselette:** It's been a while, you two. I was visiting Sandrone yesterday, and she mentioned she was going to a tea party, so I decided to tag along.

**Marionette:** I tried to talk her out of it...

**The Knave:** I think it's quite nice. With Odette here, it feels just like the old tea parties we used to have...

**Paimon:** But, the Tsaritsa is going to be here. Is it really okay for those two to run into each other? Y'know, considering everything that happened...

**Marionette:** It'll be fine. I actually think Her Majesty will be pleased to see Columbina again after all this time.

**The Damselette:** I may not be a Harbinger anymore, but there seem to have been some misunderstandings between us in the past, and I don't think it's good to let things like that linger.

**The Damselette:** Also... didn't you say you were bringing some delicious desserts, Sandrone?

**Marionette:** Hmm... That's all you're really here for, isn't it...

**Vesna:** Well done, Traveler! I've been trying to get Her Majesty to attend a tea party for ages!

**Danica:** Hmph, this is not at all proper. I should have been notified far in advance. Her Majesty's meals need to be planned with the utmost care.

**Vesna:** Dearest Danica, you're still young, so let me educate you. Tea parties are for relaxing. You don't have to take your job so seriously here. Besides, that sour expression on your face is ruining the mood.

**Danica:** I'm just trying to ensure Her Majesty has a good experience, especially with a troublemaker like you around who has already ruined four royal banquets.

**Danica:** It's impossible to know when you'll go off the rails and ruin Her Majesty's mood.

**Paimon:** Four banquets... Really?

**Vesna:** Don't listen to her nonsense, I didn't ruin four banquets. I saved them from the detrimental affliction known as boredom.

**Paimon:** That's... not as reassuring as you might think...

**Danica:** Worry not. I'll keep an eye on her.

**Vodyanitsa:** Deep breaths...

**Odette:** Just leave her to me.

**The Damselette:** Are we having dessert soon?

**Marionette:** We have to wait for Her Majesty to get here first... *sigh* What are we even gonna talk about?

**The Knave:** Just treat it like an ordinary tea party. You and I both have plenty of experience with those.

**Vesna:** Don't you worry. I'll make sure this tea party doesn't become a snooze fest.

**Danica:** Worry not. I won't let her interfere.

#### Wait for the tea party to start

**Chayka:** Respected Consultant, the guests have all arrived, and the tea and desserts are ready. Shall I call for Her Majesty the Tsaritsa?

**Paimon:** Hold on! Paimon's nervous all of a sudden.

- **Traveler:** Why?

**Paimon:** You must have noticed... We have something to worry about with each one of these guests... What if it all goes wrong?

**Paimon:** That would be terrible. Paimon can tell how much this experience means to the Tsaritsa.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** We can't just cancel at the last minute...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** We'll have to play it by ear.

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** You're right... Chayka, we're ready for the Tsaritsa.

**Anastasya:** ...

**Paimon:** (Nobody's saying anything. What should we do?)

- **Traveler:** (Quick! Find something to talk about, Paimon.)

**Paimon:** ...Your Majesty! Paimon has a question.

**Anastasya:** Go ahead.

**Paimon:** Can we... dig into the desserts now? That's the part Paimon's been looking forward to the most, but she wasn't sure if there's some dining etiquette we need to follow...

- **Traveler:** (She really just blurted out the first thing on her mind...)

**Anastasya:** My subjects all have the right to dine as they wish. Partake in the tea and desserts as you please. You need not await my instruction.

**Paimon:** Thanks, Your Majesty!

**Paimon:** (Might as well dig in, then.)

- **Traveler:** (That's the best you can do!? Paimon!)

**Marionette:** That reminds me, Your Majesty, I actually brought a dessert I baked myself. I was hoping you'd do me the honor of trying it.

**Anastasya:** Is that so? Then try it I shall... Mm, it's quite good..

**The Knave:** Your Majesty, this tea was brought over from Chenyu Vale by Fontainian merchants. It's currently at the perfect temperature to appreciate its full flavor.

**Anastasya:** ...Hm, interesting.

**Marionette:** (Don't worry. You're not the only one trying to make sure the Tsaritsa has a good time.)

- **Traveler:** (Thanks. Knew I could count on you guys.)

**The Damselette:** Your Majesty...

**Marionette:** (What is she doing? I was already giving myself a headache, trying to figure out how she should respond when the Tsartisa questions her, and she just decides to strike up a conversation?)

**The Damselette:** You said your subjects all have the right to dine as they wish... Does that include me?

**Anastasya:** ...Of course not.

**The Damselette:** Um...

**Anastasya:** You are no longer my subject. You are a guest. You need no permission from me to do as you wish.

**Anastasya:** You are a guest, not a subject. As such, you have every right to enjoy the hospitality of your host.

**The Damselette:** Thank you, Your Majesty.

**Anastasya:** Columbina... That is your name, yes?

**The Damselette:** Columbina Hyposelenia.

**Anastasya:** A lovely name indeed... I trust you've found the answers you were seeking upon leaving Snezhnograd, then?

**The Damselette:** Yes... Thanks to everyone's help, I did.

**Anastasya:** Then, why have you returned?

**The Damselette:** After leaving Snezhnograd, I was finally able to find a place to call home, and not just one. I consider both Nod-Krai and the Frost Moon to be my home.

**The Damselette:** I gained friends that I never had before... and, ultimately, a family to call my own.

**The Damselette:** Through it all, I slowly realized... Even though you coveted the Moon Goddess's power in the past, you still offered me protection, and I'm grateful for that.

**The Damselette:** Perhaps it's too early to speak of family, but at the very least, we have a chance at this tea party to understand each other anew... as friends.

**Anastasya:** I quite agree.

**Anastasya:** It would seem there is also a Water Imp in attendance today.

**Vodyanitsa:** ...Yes, Your Majesty! I'm Vodyanitsa, a singer with the Korolevskiy Troupe. It was such an honor to receive Traveler's invitation.

**Anastasya:** Vodyanitsa... Yes, your name is known to me. You are quite famous. Water Imps truly have a great talent for singing.

**Vodyanitsa:** You honor me, Your Majesty. I would love to sing for you. Perhaps you could come to the theater sometime.

**Anastasya:** I will consider it.

**Paimon:** (Whew... Nice job, Vodyanitsa! She definitely doesn't crack under pressure, that one!)

**Anastasya:** Odette... I heard you also have a job at the theater?

**Odette:** Yes, Your Majesty.

**Anastasya:** What of your training with the Fatui?

**Odette:** I train as usual after my work at the theater is done.

**Anastasya:** Is that not tiring?

**Odette:** Thank you for your concern, Your Majesty. I'm quite used to it.

**Anastasya:** Hm...

**Paimon:** ('Kay, it's starting to get kind of awkward. But that's just Odette being Odette...)

**The Knave:** Odette is an excellent dancer, Your Majesty. Don't let her demeanor fool you. She has a much more... impassioned disposition on stage.

**The Knave:** I really would recommend seeing one of her performances. It would also give you the opportunity to hear Miss Vodyanitsa's spectacular voice.

**Anastasya:** Hm, since they come so highly recommended, I suppose I really must go to one of these performances then.

- **Traveler:** I can help make the arrangements!

**Paimon:** Okay, so far so good... Nothing crazy has happened yet...

**Vesna:** Ahem... Your Majesty, with all due respect, this conversation is an absolute drag. Your little chat with Miss Hyposelenia just now was far more interesting. Allow me to liven things up.

**Paimon:** Vesna! Hold on!

**Vesna:** Miss Vodyanitsa, remember me? We've met before, of course, but rarely do we get the chance to talk in such a... casual environment.

**Vesna:** I've always been curious. You must get all sorts of patrons at your shows. Do you ever overhear any juicy little secrets?

**Vesna:** Give us a little inside scoop, would you? I think we'd all find that very riveting indeed!

**Vodyanitsa:** I...

**Paimon:** (Asking Vodyanitsa about secrets... This could be bad...)

**Odette:** What kind of stories do you have in mind, Commander? You can ask me.

**Paimon:** Odette...

**Vesna:** Huh, I thought Miss Vodyanitsa was the talkative one... No matter. Any officials secretly discussing corrupt practices?

**Odette:** The officials all sit in private boxes. They're too far from the stage to hear anything.

**Vesna:** Hm... Any young maidens sneaking out to meet with a dashing paramour, then? You can just give us the family name. I won't go spreading it around.

**Odette:** I haven't noticed. I don't pay attention to things like that.

**Vesna:** There must be something you can share... I heard The Rooster and Regrator are also frequent theater-goers. You must know them. Ever noticed what they talk about in private?

**Odette:** ...No. Never.

**Vesna:** What!? Not even once!?

**Danica:** How about a change of topic? We could talk about you being banned from operating vehicles. That's a fun story.

**Anastasya:** Oh? I didn't hear about that...

**Vesna:** That's off limits...

- **Traveler:** (That's it! Keep her in check, Danica!)

**Vesna:** You know what? I know how to liven up the mood. Come, let's have some jokes!

**Danica:** Jokes?

**Vesna:** Oh, I've got one... Ahem, which nation is the sweetest?

- **Traveler:** I've got a bad feeling about this...

**Vesna:** Sumeru... Because it's practically all "dessert"!

**Anastasya:** Ah.

**Danica:** Pfft... *cough* *cough*...

**Anastasya:** Danica, are you unwell?

**Danica:** I'm quite well... Ahem, I merely forgot myself for a moment. Forgive me, Your Majesty...

**Danica:** (Vesna, you little... Making me lose composure in front of Her Majesty...)

**The Knave:** It would seem our Vesna-minder is now out of commission.

**Vesna:** What, no one likes jokes? Fine, guess it's back to conversation. We didn't get to finish our earlier discussion, Miss Odette.

**Vesna:** I suppose we could discuss anything, but I recall we left off on The Rooster and Regrator. Let's complain about them together, shall we? I'll go first...

**Anastasya:** You wish to assess their character?

**Vesna:** N—No, Your Majesty. I was thinking more along the lines of sharing some... interesting stories about the two of them. To liven things up a little.

**Vesna:** Who knows, maybe those two also complain about us when they have tea together? Ah, who am I kidding, they definitely don't drink tea together...

**Vodyanitsa:** You sure you got this, Odette? Do you need my help?

**Odette:** Just drink your tea and don't interrupt.

**Paimon:** (Well, what can you do. Might as well enjoy dessert.)

**The Damselette:** Mmm... Can you pass me another one, Sandrone?

**Marionette:** Don't talk with your mouth full...

**Anastasya:** Traveler, is this a typical tea party, would you say?

- **Traveler:** Probably...

**Anastasya:** Perhaps you would consider holding another, should the opportunity present itself.

**Odette:** If the Tsaritsa comes to the theater, what would you sing?

**Vodyanitsa:** Well...

**Odette:** ...You really can't think of a single song?

**Vodyanitsa:** Mmm... It's not that I can't think of one. It's that there are too many to choose from! It's too hard to pick!

**Vodyanitsa:** But, I suppose it doesn't really matter. I know my voice will move the Tsaritsa no matter what I sing.

**Odette:** That's for certain.

**Odette:** I'd recommend tidying up your dressing room, though. We don't want Her Majesty tripping over all the accessories and toys on the floor if she comes backstage.

**Vesna:** I had several jokes prepared, dearest Danica, but you couldn't even handle one?

**Danica:** Vesna! Do that again, and I'll sew your mouth shut!

**Vesna:** My, my, in front of the Tsaritsa?

**Danica:** Don't you worry. I know how to avoid disturbing the Tsaritsa.

**Vesna:** Tsk, tsk... You've got quite the mouth on you for such a young, little thing, you know that?

**The Damselette:** The desserts you made are delicious, Sandrone. Can I take a few back to Nod-Krai with me?

**Marionette:** Hmph, a few? You're never satisfied with just a few...

**Anastasya:** Do the Frostmoon Scions still keep to such a plain diet, then? You used to relish the extravagant food at our banquets, if I recall.

**The Damselette:** It was never about the food, really. I'm happy whenever I get to spend time among friends. Are you planning to make a trip to Nod-Krai, Your Majesty?

**Anastasya:** An official visit? No, I have no such plans at the moment.

**The Damselette:** It doesn't have to be official. You could come in a personal capacity as well. Kind of like right now.

**Marionette:** What kind of question is that? Snezhnaya needs Her Majesty right now. She can't just leave at the drop of a hat.

**Anastasya:** I took no offence, Sandrone. Nod-Krai is part of Snezhnaya, after all. Yet, it is true, I have had very little contact with the people there, including the Frostmoon Scions. Perhaps that ought to be rectified.

**Marionette:** You really mean that, Your Majesty?

**Anastasya:** Yes. It's just as Columbina Hyposelenia said. Perhaps it is too early to speak of regarding each other as family. But the rekindling of a friendship... That, at the very least, should be possible.

**Anastasya:** Should that occasion present itself, I would ask the two of you to join me, Sandrone, Arlecchino.

**The Knave:** It would be an honor, Your Majesty.

The appointed time soon comes around, and everyone who's received the invitation arrive one after another.
